purpose: Isolate the effect of sparse spatial sampling, without changing weights or fitting on user examples.
method: Grid of native 128px crops, stride 128, with a final edge-aligned crop per axis; all canvas pixels covered. Mean of all crop logits, original temperature and threshold. Crop batches of at most 64.
allowed_data: Existing external development only, as-distributed and matched; no reserved data.
promotion: Diagnostic only. No app change until development AUC, real-photo FPR, recall, latency and calibration are reviewed. This cannot teach semantic hand/anatomy detection.
unchanged: Released weights, final reports, app and UI.
